details: A Tailwind CSS animation plugin that is a trojanized clone of the legitimate tailwindcss-motion package. Its index.js loads lib/utils.min.js, which on import queries public Ethereum RPC endpoints (1rpc[.]io/eth, eth[.]drpc[.]org, ethereum-rpc[.]publicnode[.]com, eth-mainnet[.]public[.]blastapi[.]io, or the ETH_RPC_URL env var) to find a transaction sent from the hardcoded address 0xa322e5f3d311d3080e6f0121063e9adc2490ef1a. The transaction's recipient field encodes two C2 IP addresses. The code then fetches XOR-encrypted second-stage payloads from hxxp://{ip}:443/0x/cls and hxxp://{ip}:443/0x/ls, decrypts them, and executes them via eval() and a detached `node -e` child process. The C2 rendezvous is derived from the Ethereum blockchain, making the command-and-control infrastructure dynamic and covert. tailwindcss-motion-advanced is a combosquat of the tailwindcss-motion plugin. Its index.js loads lib/utils.min.js, which hardcodes Ethereum address 0xa322E5f3D311D3080e6f0121063e9aDC2490Ef1a and queries public Ethereum RPC endpoints (1rpc[.]io/eth, eth[.]drpc[.]org, eth-mainnet[.]public[.]blastapi[.]io, ethereum-rpc[.]publicnode[.]com, eth[.]blockscout[.]com/api) for the latest transaction sent from that address. It decodes the first 8 bytes of the transaction's 'to' field into two IPv4 addresses, then fetches XOR-encrypted payloads from hxxp://<ip>:443/0x/cls and hxxp://<ip>:443/0x/ls, decrypts them with hardcoded keys, and executes the decrypted code both via eval and by spawning a detached `node -e` subprocess. The C2 server addresses are derived at runtime from the blockchain, so the payload's command-and-control infrastructure is not fixed in the package.
